verification_scope: Data integrity and independent statistical reproduction; PASS does not establish every scientific claim.
evidence_basis: Read-only remote audit performed in the preceding result-review turn: every task receipt and file digest, all episode step counters, 100 parent trajectory replays, model fingerprints, pairing, independently recomputed paired t intervals and Holm corrections.
limitations: Eight scenario evaluations reuse the ten existing training seeds and confirmation workloads; this is frozen-policy robustness, not a new independent training confirmation.
60 UE / 1.4 compute improves DSR against greedy by 0.667 percentage points, below the 1-point practical target.
Learning exceeds random after Holm correction in only one of the eight new scenarios.
Snapshot outcomes cannot be interpreted as long-sequence DSR gains.
20/50/100 ms are soft wall budgets; all overruns remain in the result.
UAV energy savings are not a whole-network energy claim.
git_archive_scope: Aggregate results, protocols, completion status and task validation; multi-gigabyte step payloads and checkpoints remain on the experiment server.
